source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Διονύσιος του Περεγιασλάβλ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(; - 1645)». Its one sentence is the whole of the notice, and it prints no hymn. The corpus holds a dozen others of this name and none of them is a recluse of Pereyaslavl-Zalessky or is kept on this day; the only folder that touches the place is Ephrem of Kiev, bishop of Pereyaslavl, of the eleventh century.
